name: @ingcreators/workflow-app-docs-site-example
description: Astro 5 docs site for the workflow-app example. Consumes the sibling docs/books/*.mdx via a glob loader so the same MDX source serves both the docs site AND any future XLSX export from the annot-docs-xlsx CLI. NOT a workspace package — depends on locally-vendored Astro components until @ingcreators/annot-product-docs-astro@0.1.1 republishes with a working dist/ (see ../README.md, fix #947).
